channel.description: Recent content in Release on Alwaldend

item.title: head
item.description:
• Render hermetic Mermaid diagrams and publish the migration post

    Render Mermaid diagrams with pinned Chrome and fonts, a shared hand-drawn theme, and Dagre left-to-right layouts. Preserve nested title coordinates while lifting titles above edges, embed the handwriting font, and prevent hostname labels from clipping. Apply the same rendering setup to the Bazel rule and interactive CLI, with regression coverage for fonts and title layout.
